Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", "{\"ocr\":{\"enabled\":false,\"pipeline\":{\"quality_thresholds\":{},\"stages\":[{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"priority\":100,\"tesseract_config\":{\"enable_table_detection\":false,\"psm\":6}},{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"paddle_ocr_settings\":{\"enable_table_detection\":true,\"model_tier\":\"server\",\"use_angle_cls\":true},\"priority\":90}]}}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
